is_anopheles.evidence: Studies field populations of Anopheles gambiae s.l. (specifically An. gambiae s.s. and An. arabiensis) in south-western Nigeria (page 2-3).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Assessed Vgsc L995F ('kdr mutations in An. gambiae ss. populations [17]' referencing Martinez-Torres et al. 1998, page 3).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 4 on page 9 reports the number of mosquitoes tested (n = 30 per site) and PCR-kdr outcome ('No Kdr', meaning 100% SS / 0% resistant allele frequency) across 6 localities of An. gambiae s.s.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquito larvae were collected from breeding sites across 5 states in south-western Nigeria (Ogun, Oyo, Osun, Ondo, Ekiti) and reared to adults (page 2).

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary research study investigating insecticide resistance and breeding site characteristics (pages 1-10).

sub_country_location.evidence: Identifies 15 specific sampling sites/localities across 5 states in Nigeria, including Ojoo, Bashorun, UI, Challenge, Lagere, Modakeke, etc. (Table 1 and Table 4).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The exact collection dates or years are not reported anywhere in the text, tables, or figures.

duplicate_risk.evidence: Portions of data are linked to the first author's 2004 MSc thesis at the University of Ibadan (reference 18), but this is the primary peer-reviewed publication of the data.

supplement.evidence: All relevant bioassay and molecular characterization data (PCR-species, PCR-form, PCR-kdr) are presented in the main text and Table 4.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated permethrin susceptibility and breeding site characteristics (particularly petroleum spillage) in Anopheles gambiae s.l. from south-western Nigeria. WHO tube bioassays with 0.75% permethrin were performed on adult females from 15 localities. Molecular form and kdr genotyping (Vgsc L995F) were conducted on 30 An. gambiae s.s. females from each of 6 localities (180 total), finding an absence of the kdr mutation across all tested specimens.
